skills.title: Regular -ar verbs: yo in the preterite
skills.description: Form the first-person singular preterite of regular Spanish -ar verbs. Exclude spelling changes, irregular verbs, other persons, and other tenses.

exercises.explanation: For yo in the preterite, replace -ar with -é: hablar → hablé.
For yo in the preterite, replace -ar with -é: trabajar → trabajé.
For yo in the preterite, replace -ar with -é: comprar → compré.
